captions.detailed: A teaching-lab benchtop microscope featuring a broad, light gray base and a vertical supporting arm. It includes a dark gray monocular optical tube, a rotating nosepiece turret with multiple objectives, and a black mechanical specimen stage equipped with a side carriage and coaxial adjustment knobs. The optical assembly slides vertically along the main column for focusing, while the nosepiece turret rotates continuously, and the stage carriage slides prismatically across the stage guide.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a teaching-lab benchtop microscope. Ensure it has a broad rectangular base with rounded corners, a vertical support column, a sliding cylindrical optical body with an angled monocular tube, a rotating objective turret, and a separate black mechanical stage with a prismatic side carriage and coaxial adjustment knobs.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a rounded box, and extrude a vertical support arm. Create the main central column using a cylinder. Model the optical body as a cylinder that slides along this column, attaching a blocky nosepiece and an angled monocular tube. Form the objective turret using a flat cylinder with multiple smaller downward-pointing cylinders for the objectives. Build the specimen stage as a thin rectangular plate with a central hole, adding a side bracket, a prismatic sliding carriage, and a pair of coaxial cylindrical control knobs.
